subtasks.label: Hero with Title & Meta

Back button (circular, top-left overlay), edge-to-edge hero photo with bottom gradient scrim, workout title 'Full Body Strength' on scrim, meta row (duration 45 min · 12 exercises · 320 kcal), difficulty badge group (Beginner / Intermediate chips with Intermediate active), pinned inside hero area

Section heading 'Exercises (6)', scrollable list of six exercise rows, each row = rounded thumbnail image + exercise name + secondary line 'sets × reps' (e.g. '3 sets × 12 reps') + chevron; rows: Warm-up Stretch, Goblet Squat, Push-Ups, Dumbbell Row, Plank Hold, Cool-down Stretch
